execution_unit: one full-shape GPTQ execution per alpha per Linear; all output rows are produced by each call
group_layout: 24 x [qkv shared input, o, up/gate shared input, down]
formula: sum over 168 Linear: 10 full-Linear candidate GPTQ calls + all-row score/select/stitch/commit; add 96 unique input/H groups; sequential layer execution with dependency-local group activations; one set of checkpoint writes

assumptions.candidate_core: retains v17.2 per-shape measured full-Linear alpha timings with the existing 2x conservative scenario; no v17.3 speedup credit
assumptions.capture: v15 FP activation capture 2.640204s at 48x128 tokens, scaled by token ratio 42.666667, sequence-shape factor 1.25, and 2x global safety
assumptions.sequential_forward: v15 quantized-prefix full forward 3.674337s at 48x128 tokens, token-scaled, sequence-shape factor 1.25, and 2x global safety
assumptions.boundary_replay: v15 replay of 16 target blocks scaled to 96 unique activation groups and formal token count, sequence-shape factor 1.25, and 2x global safety; deliberately conservative proxy
assumptions.hessian: v15 measured 2.053313s for 32 H builds at 4096 token rows; scaled to 96 shared-input H groups and formal tokens, 2x safety
assumptions.scoring_stitch: retains v17.2 15-minute central assumption, doubled; covers direct all-row score selection, rowwise stitch and commit pending matched-shape measurement
assumptions.io: retains v17.2 two 942.3 MiB checkpoint writes at 180 MiB/s with 2x safety

limitations: No full-model M2 run was performed.
Full-sequence capture/replay estimates are extrapolated from v15 128-token runs, not matched 2048-token measurements.
The 96-group boundary replay proxy is intentionally conservative and may overlap the sequential forward work; it is retained as a separate upper-cost allowance.
The cost model does not claim measured full-model wall time.
supersedes: v17.2 M2_COST_ESTIMATE.json for the full-model decision only; v17.2 files remain immutable
v17_2_invalid_terms: 133.076 seconds was copied from v15 prefix_native_quantization_seconds_measured, which is native GPTQ quantization time, not activation capture time.
HISTORICAL_TIMING_EVIDENCE.json contains no native_full_prefix_seconds key, so the v17.2 fallback hard-coded 133.076 seconds.
The 4x full-prefix refresh term treated four within-layer dependency boundaries as four extra complete full-model forward passes.
Hessian build scale counted 168 projections separately despite qkv and up/gate sharing their input and H; 96 unique group inputs are required.
